name: What does a roof assessment process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does a roof assessment process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our severe weather roof assessment process typically begins with an exterior inspection, examining shingles, flashing, gutters, and other roof components for visible storm damage. This is followed by a detailed attic inspection to check for leaks, water stains, or structural compromise not visible from the outside. We document our findings with photos and provide a comprehensive report outlining any damage, recommended repairs, and potential next steps for insurance claims. The whole process aims to give you a clear understanding of your roof's condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: The assessment involves an exterior roof inspection and an attic check for leaks or damage. We document findings with photos and provide a detailed report.
